newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish police seize 60 kg of heroin.
newsitem.headline: Turkish police seize 60 kg of heroin.

text.p: Turkish police have seized 60 kg (132 lb) of heroin worth about $950,000 hidden in a vegetable lorry in the east of the country, Anatolian news agency said on Tuesday.
Police said the drugs had been smuggled from nearby Iran.
Four people, including the lorry driver, were arrested while three others, one of them Iranian, were still being sought, the agency quoted officials as saying.
Turkey is one of the major transit countries for heroin from Iran, Pakistan and Afghanistan on its way to western Europe.
